Researcher ismaelsadeeq (Nov 25, 2026) says an attacker can plant a low-fee payment and see which node re-announces it. Per the author's reading of the code, a node using Tor or I2P plus clearnet peers also re-announces over clearnet, exposing its IP. Only nodes with no clearnet peers avoid that. Regtest result: 30/30 links. No real-world attack reported. # Bitcoin # Tor # I2P # Privacy https:// delvingbitcoin.org/t/exploitin g-wallet-rebroadcast-to-link-addresses-to-node-ips-and-more/3123
